judge_notes.opus5: The arithmetic off a company-published number: Q3 originations were pre-released at $4,117.8m, -2.6% q/q, and at Q2's 8.23% take rate that is ~$356m of revenue against a ~$365m consensus unmoved since Oct 5, so the bar embeds a ~20bp take-rate rise management said would be stable; separately the ~$1.4bn FY guide implies H2 ~$727m against a street Q3+Q4 of ~$750m, so a plain reaffirm reads as an implied Q4 cut. Shrunk for 26% of float short at the 52-week low with a +16.8 put skew already paying for this.
